headline: Anthropic debiutuje na giełdzie. Oto kurs akcji
summary: Anthropic shares began trading at $111.50 on their debut day, 34% above the IPO offer price, according to Bloomberg. The debut was the company's first day of trading.
why: An IPO price-to-open gap indicates how strongly investors are bidding for a newly listed company. It helps set valuations for other AI listings.
why_moved: Demand for the shares pushed the opening price to $111.50, 34% above the IPO offer price.
